init.happening: Build the table and seed single characters.
init.why: Single characters are the base palindromes.

loop.why: Longer palindromes build on shorter ones.

move.happening: Slide the span start or grow the length.

update.happening: Mark a palindrome or record a new best.
update.why: The table and best span are maintained.
update.invariant: dp records true spans; best tracks the longest.

check.happening: Test the ends, the inner span, or a new best.
check.why: These decide the palindrome rule and the answer.
check.invariant: A span is a palindrome only by the rule.

return.invariant: The answer is the best span.
